LESSON: READING ALOUD

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.9: Reading Aloud
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading Aloud, part of Reading in Grade 4 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: What strategies can you use to identify main ideas in texts? 2. How does decoding accuracy impact reading comprehension?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read simple sentences and underline vocabulary related to household items and various areas of the home,

2. play a game of matching title card with the appropriate detail card from a sentence basket on household items and their locations,

3. listen to word clues and identify the corresponding phonetic pattern on a set of cards,

4. conduct word hunts and search for words in texts that contain specific phonetic patterns or sounds collaboratively,

5. team up with peers to use surrounding words and sentences to determine the meaning of the unknown words in the text, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read simple sentences and underline vocabulary related to household items and various areas of the home,
2. play a game of matching title card with the appropriate detail card from a sentence basket on household items and their locations,
3. listen to word clues and identify the corresponding phonetic pattern on a set of cards,
4. conduct word hunts and search for words in texts that contain specific phonetic patterns or sounds collaboratively,
5. team up with peers to use surrounding words and sentences to determine the meaning of the unknown words in the text, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading Aloud together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Critical thinking and Problem solving: Interpretation and inference skills are developed when the learner uses surrounding

words and sentences to determine the meaning of the unknown words in the text.

Values:
Integrity: The learner displays self-discipline as they work with peers to create word walls of common patterns and sounds.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCis):

Environmental awareness: The learner gains an awareness on the importance of placing items in their appropriate places

01 areas at home.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to link their learning to Kiswahili and English on the concept of using contextual clues to find the

meaning of unfamiliar words in reading texts.
